title: Rav Huna bar Ada
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: According to the reading in Dikdukei Soferim, Rav Huna bar Ada is mentioned in [Berakhot 62b](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.62b.18), speaking in the name of Rav Sama son of Rav Mari. Hyman gives the received reading as Rav Chana bar Ada.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The linked Berakhot names Rav Chana bar Ada transmitting in the name of Rav Sama son of Rav Mari. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1373&lang=en) gives the same chain. The supplied transcription reads Rav Na bar Ada.

Hyman’s print (vol. I, p. 347) reads Rav Chana bar Ada, with the letter missing from the supplied transcription. [Dikdukei Soferim on Berakhot, p. 364](https://www.google.com/books/edition/_/ZWuq1txyjt8C?hl=en&gbpv=1&pg=PA364) prints Chana in the received-text column and Huna in the Munich manuscript column. Both readings retain the attribution to Rav Sama son of Rav Mari in the discussion of a shortcut through the Temple Mount.
